{{Quote|The court of Jedi Affairs stands now in session, the honorable Arabelle Lorteli presiding. Be seated and be quiet.|A court sergeant announces Zoolli Judge Loteli|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
The '''Zoolli''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], distinguished from [[Human/Legends|Humans]] by their longer [[Nose/Legends|noses]]. [[Judge/Legends|Judge]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]] was a Zoolli member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Court of Justice|judiciary]]. She was personally appointed by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]]; however, the [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] of State later publicly removed her from that post after allegations that the Zoolli had been [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] by members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Zoolli were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] physique. They appeared remarkably like members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] species, with the exception of exhibiting thinner, longer [[Nose/Legends|noses]]. The Zoolli [[Arabelle Lorteli]] had [[Color/Legends|blue]] colored [[Hair/Legends|hair]], arching eyebrows, and a wide-lipped [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. She spoke in a pinched, nasal voice.<ref name="Abyss" />

==History==
The Zoolli were established in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[43 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Zoolli Arabelle Lorteli was personally selected by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to serve as a [[Judge/Legends|judge]] on the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]]. In that role, she presided over the [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|arraignment]] of former-[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tahiri Veila]] before the court, and denied Veila legal representation by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Lawyer/Legends|counselor]] [[Nawara Ven]] on the grounds of a conflict of interest with the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. Judge Lorteli later signed a writ for members of the Jedi Order providing them permission to visit [[Valin Horn]] and [[Jysella Horn]] who were being held in an [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse|Alliance prison]]. When made aware of this writ, Daala insinuated that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the Zoolli to obtain the writ.<ref name="Abyss" /> Following this incident, the [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] of State publicly removed Judge Lorteli from her position.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Zoolli were created by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Troy Denning]] for his novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2009]] as book three in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. The Zoolli character Arabelle Lorteli is also mentioned in the fifth novel in the series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', but does not make an appearance.
